implementation_summary: auditExportRoutes({store, settings, exportOptions?}) returns three GET rows (export, pitch, owner) with access 'export' taken from AUDIT_API. Each validates query values (400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST), loads the finished version's result, Page Content, edits and settings, calls exportAudit / exportPitchGlimpse / exportOwnerAudit, and replies with the file: EXPORT_CONTENT_TYPES content type, attachment with a sanitized name, no-store, nosniff. Running gives 409 ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING, unknown or result-less gives 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND. Store and render failures give fixed sentences. No outbound calls.
